scoring_justification: Derived mechanical/thermal properties (B, G, E, Θ_D) and magnetic moment are recomputed from raw elastic constants and lattice parameters using hexagonal VRH formulas and compared to paper-reported gold. Full recompute from raw artifacts is feasible.

outputs.description: Relaxed lattice parameters, total magnetic moment, and five elastic constants of pristine Ti3AlC2.
Relaxed lattice parameters, magnetic moment, and elastic constants for Hf substitutionally doped at the Ti1 site in Ti3AlC2.
Relaxed lattice parameters, magnetic moment, and elastic constants for Hf interstitially doped at the c-ATi2 site in Ti3AlC2.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute bulk modulus, shear modulus, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and Debye temperature from the raw elastic constants using the hexagonal Voigt-Reuss-Hill formulas, and will compare against paper-reported values with tolerances. Trend validation will enforce that interstitial doping reduces derived moduli by more than 10% compared to pristine, while substitutional doping remains within 5%.
